info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Production Risk Models API
info.description: The Production Risk Models API provides access to critical risk assessment models used in the banking sector. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information on specific risk models by their unique identifiers. It is particularly useful for financial analysts and risk management professionals seeking to evaluate or integrate these models into their applications. Typical use cases include assessing the potential impact of various risk factors and enhancing decision-making processes in financial institutions.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific production risk model by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific production risk model using its unique identifier. You can use this information for analysis or auditing purposes.
